blocked_control.public_requirement: A documentation-only catalog-relevant source must remain a public PARTIAL mechanism with explicit provenance.
contract_references: R3 section 5, extraction rules 5-7: RuleID must match a literal accepted_evidence_rules entry; role and witness_kind come only from that catalog entry; DOCUMENTATION requires the homonymous source kind.
R3 section 5, status rules: PARTIAL needs at least one positive bundle-bound source; isolated documentation is capped at PARTIAL.
R3 section 15, mandatory control 4: isolated documentation is at most PARTIAL.
derivation: A documentation EvidenceSource can participate only through a literal catalog rule whose witness_kind is DOCUMENTATION.
The frozen v2 catalog contains no such accepted evidence rule.
Using an unknown RuleID yields a gap rather than a mechanism; borrowing a differently typed catalog rule fails structural compatibility.
Therefore no input under the frozen R3 plus rules-v2 pair can make P02 both documentation-only and a genuine public PARTIAL mechanism.

o7_disposition.required_resolution: Publish a new, internally consistent contract/catalog revision and rebind the adversarial controls before freezing O7.
